skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop advanced reading and writing skills in English at the B2 to C1 level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), equivalent to IELTS 6.0-6.5.
Apply critical thinking to reading and writing tasks, including identifying arguments, distinguishing between facts and opinions, and analyzing complex texts.
Enhance teamwork and collaborative skills in group activities and discussions.
Master various academic writing styles, including descriptive essays, argumentative essays, and problem-solution essays.
Expand vocabulary through context, dictionary usage, and advanced reading materials.
Prepare for international English proficiency tests such as IELTS.
Develop self-study and self-assessment skills to enhance independent learning.
